channel.title: The Drill Down: Pittsburgh Steelers
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 12: Broncos at Steelers
item.description: Fri 11/27 · 3:00 PM ET | Line: DEN -3 · O/U 38.5 | Model PIT 47% vs. market 31% | Pittsburgh's deep passing decides this one: the Steelers rank 30th in EPA per deep attempt, and Denver's defense allows +0.33 on those throws, so Pittsburgh must stretch the field. Jaylen Warren tops the league in rushing yards over expected per carry at +2.1, and he runs into a Denver run defense ranked 14th. Our model gives Denver 53%, well under the market's 69%, and the passing matchup drives most of that lean toward the Broncos.

item.title: Week 11: Steelers at Eagles
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 4:25 PM ET | Line: PIT -4.5 · O/U 38.5 | Model PHI 37% vs. market 35% | Pittsburgh's ground game is the pressure point, since the Steelers lead the league in EPA per designed run and the Eagles' run defense ranks 16th, so Philadelphia must bottle it up before play-action opens. Jaylen Warren, first in rushing yards over expected at +2.1 per carry, is the back who has to turn that edge into first downs. Our model agrees with the market on Pittsburgh, and the rushing matchup, worth 6.2 points, drives most of our number.

item.title: Week 10: Steelers at Bengals
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 8:20 PM ET | Line: CIN -3.5 · O/U 49.5 | Model CIN 59% vs. market 66% | The game turns on whether Pittsburgh can establish the run early, since its designed runs rank 1st in EPA while Cincinnati's run defense ranks 26th. Jaylen Warren, the league's best at +2.1 rushing yards over expected per carry, has to carry that load while Aaron Rodgers faces Joe Burrow, who ranks 1st among quarterbacks. Our model gives Cincinnati a 59% win chance against a market price of 66%, a gap driven by the starting QB and passing matchup.
